meaning: Under the frozen static covariance and stationary linear-loop model at 1e5 detected electrons per fully illuminated subaperture per frame, the selected admissible comparator does not meet the C1 material-benefit trigger. C3 is therefore not triggered by this evaluation. Total closed-loop response and other operating conditions remain unmeasured.
quantity: stationary detector-noise component of the reconstructed pupil wavefront (static model prediction, full cross-modal covariance)
not_quantities: the RMS of a paired difference
an estimate of a closed-loop comparison's effect size or detectability

difference.description: baseline minus comparator component RMS prediction

decision_rule.rule: material benefit requires both triggers, each beyond its guard band

comparator_selection.rule: largest grid alpha with tip, tilt and defocus nominal one-shot gains finite and within [0.99, 1.01]

numerical_consistency_indicator.meaning: empirical agreement of independent numerical paths; not a certified error bound and not a statistical interval

images: none: C1 generated no PSFs, no images and no replay frames
not_established: other photon budgets, realizations, detector settings or masks
alpha 0.0015 and 0.002 (admissible, not propagated) and dampings outside the grid

identities.note: records are held in the project's private evidence archive and identified here by SHA-256
